text: わたし　ほんとは　ポケモン　よく　わからないの　つかう　ポケモンも　かっこう　だけで　きめちゃうのよ

structure.jp: ポケモン　よく　わからないの
つかう　ポケモンも
かっこう　だけで　きめちゃうのよ
structure.en: I just pick by looks alone

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right in front of a thing tells you which thing it is. つかう　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I use'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells what you go by when you do something. かっこう　だけで = 'by looks alone'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says you go and do it without much thought; ちゃう is its casual short form. きめちゃう = 'I just go and decide'.
